metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for agentic SDLC, brain harness, Effect-TS awareness, and shared memory. Mirrors the Cursor/Codex bundle in this repo.

plugins.name: umo-brain
plugins.description: Brain harness — Brain MCP (david-brain) plus a SessionStart hook and brain-harness skill for shared memory across repos and sessions.

plugins.name: umo-sdlc
plugins.description: UMO SDLC v1 — Markdown-first docs buckets, typed document lifecycles, service passports, service.catalog.json sidecars, Beads planning, SDD/TDD routing, and repo health diagnostics. Ships skills (docs, planning, how-to) and slash commands (/sdd, /docs, /planning, /how-to).

plugins.name: umo-effect
plugins.description: Effect-TS — always-on awareness rule plus effect-ts skill (guides and references). Load the skill when work involves Effect.

plugins.name: umo-jira-tracker
plugins.description: UMO JIRA Tracker — links JIRA tickets to a local Beads database, automates sprint sync, drives commit/MR creation with STD-JIRA naming, and syncs outcomes back to JIRA.
